name: CRM
brief: Native CRM for Business Central — accounts, activities, opportunities and a guided sales process, without Dataverse.
description: Native Business Central CRM that reimplements Dynamics 365 Sales / Dataverse capabilities — record ownership & teams, a unified activity timeline, opportunity management with product lines and stakeholders, and guided business process flows — directly in BC, with no Dataverse or CRM connector required. Built to AppSource standards in the PTE object range.
